column7: STORAGE-ERR-CLASS-5 item 3: DELETE /auth/tokens/{id} answered 404 "Token not found" for every error after the token read, so a failed revoke write told the caller the token was gone while it still authenticated. core.RevokeOwnPAT now types the true not-found (absent, another user's, id 0) as ErrPATNotFound; the handler answers 404 only for it, 503 for a storage-read or audit-unavailable refusal and 500 for a failed write. Sibling: internal/core TestRevokeOwnPAT_NotFoundIsTypedAndFaultIsNot. Red on main (behaviour). CreateSecretAccessRequest pre-check and AcknowledgeAnomalyAlert were already classified by ERR-FOLD-HANDLERS-1 (SecretReadVerdictFault; ErrAnomalyAlertNotFound).
